body.heading: Where in the world is Antigua and Barbuda?
paragraphs: Antigua and Barbuda is a country in the Caribbean, which is part of North America. It is an island country, surrounded by sea.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Antigua and Barbuda is Saint John's.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Antigua and Barbuda is English.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Antigua and Barbuda is the East Caribbean dollar.

body.heading: How big is Antigua and Barbuda?
paragraphs: Antigua and Barbuda covers about 442 square kilometres of land and inland water.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Nelson's Dockyard is a working Georgian naval base turned marina — stone warehouses, sailboats and the Shirley Heights lookout with its famous Sunday views.
A boat ride away, quiet Barbuda has blush-pink sand and one of the world's largest frigate bird colonies in its lagoon sanctuary.
